title: Separation Package Analyzer
description: Models the after-tax take-home value of a separation package offer. Handles lump-sum (IRS supplemental 22%/37% flat rate, no FICA) and salary-continuation (2024 IRS Pub 15-T brackets, FICA applicable) payment structures. User-entered state income tax rate. Optional runway estimate (net take-home ÷ monthly expenses). Inline legal disclaimer. AP2 export with downstream handoff to AL-08+14.
data_vintage: IRS Publication 15-T (2024) · IRS Rev. Proc. 2023-34 (2024 brackets) · 2024 FICA wage base $168,600

gross_package_usd.description: Total gross separation package amount in USD

current_annual_salary_usd.description: Current annual base salary for withholding reference

state_tax_rate_pct.description: User-entered state income tax rate as a percentage (0–15)

monthly_expenses_usd.description: Monthly living expenses for runway calculation (optional)

cobra_premium_usd.description: Monthly COBRA continuation premium during job search (optional)

ui_weekly_benefit_usd.description: Estimated weekly unemployment insurance benefit (optional; reduces burn rate)

prior_year_ss_wages_usd.description: Prior-year Social Security wages; used to compute remaining FICA-subject headroom under the $168,600 wage base (optional)

mcp_tool_definition.name: analyze_separation_package
mcp_tool_definition.description: Given a separation package amount, payment type (lump sum vs. salary continuation), filing status, and state tax rate, returns after-tax net take-home using IRS Publication 15-T 2024 withholding rules. Optionally computes runway months if monthly expenses provided. Returns AP2 severance_decision_record mandate.

gross_package_usd.description: Total gross package amount in USD

state_tax_rate_pct.description: State income tax rate as a percentage (0–15); 0 for no-income-tax states

monthly_expenses_usd.description: Monthly living expenses for runway calculation (optional)

cobra_premium_usd.description: Monthly COBRA continuation premium during job search (optional)

ui_weekly_benefit_usd.description: Estimated weekly unemployment insurance benefit (optional; reduces effective burn rate)

prior_year_ss_wages_usd.description: Prior-year SS wages to compute remaining FICA-subject headroom under $168,600 wage base (optional)
